Any object may begin with an optional "thought" field: one free-text string of reasoning, at most 2048 bytes, written before the action. Memory fields are arrays of strings, at most 32 strings each, 512 bytes per string, 8192 bytes total; preserve useful facts when replacing memory. Model memory cannot mark host verification passed. A legacy {"memory":"notes"} is also accepted. Use fields in listed order. No markdown.
apply_patch(path:string old_text:string new_text:string): Replace one exact unique text span; empty old_text creates a new file. Parent directory must exist. old_text must match the CURRENT file content byte for byte. Both strings are JSON: write each line break as \n and each tab as \t; a replacement of several statements is one string containing \n, not a single line. In Go, statements cannot share a line without a semicolon, so write each statement on its own line with \n.
apply_hunk(path:string start:line end:line file_sha256:string new_text:string): Replace an inclusive 1-based line range in an existing text file. file_sha256 must equal the full-file anchor returned by read_file, so stale line numbers cannot edit changed bytes. new_text is the exact replacement, including any required final line break. Prefer this for narrow edits; use apply_patch to create files or replace a non-line text span.
expand_output(id:uint offset:uint): Read up to 8192 bytes of recorded UTF-8 tool text by id. A byte offset inside a character advances to the next character.
find_symbol(name:string depth:uint): Inspect a Go symbol. depth 0=signature, 1=body, 2=neighbors, 3=file.
get_references(name:string): Find Go identifier occurrences; these are syntactic, not type-resolved.
git_diff(): Inspect Git diff; configured filters require process authorization.
git_status(): Inspect Git status; configured filters require process authorization.
list_directory(): List indexed repository paths.
read_file(path:string start:line end:line): Read inclusive lines: start>=1, end>=start, at most 2001 lines. The first output line is file_sha256:<hex>, an anchor for a later apply_hunk call.
retrieve_context(query:string): Retrieve indexed evidence: exact Go symbol, package imports, literal text, then full-text search. JSON includes source hashes, excerpts, stage order and explicit limits; graph is syntactic, not resolved calls/types.
run_command(argv:strings): Run an argv array without a shell. Requires explicit process authorization.
search_text(query:string): Literal text search across indexed source files.
